create_bigbird_tokenizer: create a BigBirdTokenizer instance with custom vocab and special tokens like cls, sep, pad, bos, eos
build_bigbird_tokenizer_fast: build a fast BigBird tokenizer backed by the HuggingFace tokenizers library using Unigram model
configure_bigbird_tokenizer_special_toke: configure BigBirdTokenizer with special tokens cls, sep, mask, pad, bos, eos, and unk tokens
setup_bigbird_tokenizer_metaspace: setup BigBirdTokenizer with Metaspace normalization, pre-tokenizer, and decoder for SentencePiece-style tokenization
configure_bigbird_tokenizer_post_process: configure BigBirdTokenizer post processor with TemplateProcessing for single and pair sequence inputs
